suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-14 adds this relationship only as the user-approved bounded clinical proposition. A population-based cohort found an elevated risk of new-onset depression after hospital-diagnosed hidradenitis suppurativa; the approved relationship is limited to temporal association/risk and does not assert individual causation. Require independently established hidradenitis suppurativa before first-onset depressive disorder; do not use this proposition for depression predating hidradenitis suppurativa. Preserve obesity, smoking, substance use, socioeconomic factors, other psychiatric illness, chronic-pain burden, treatment effects, and other competing explanations. Treat this only as population-level temporal risk, not proof that hidradenitis suppurativa caused an individual depressive disorder. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
